findings.finding: Two registered direct offerings priced a week ago, 3.2m shares/pre-funded warrants at $12.00 (9-23) and 1.32m shares at $13.00 (9-28), about a third of the 13.3m post-deal share count, are now 35-40% underwater at $7.85 and freely tradable; that seller is not shown to be finished.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shares are registered and already delivered (closings ~9-24 and ~9-29), so any remaining holder can sell into Monday's session; no lock-up binds the investors (the 30-day lock-up covers directors and officers only).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the 9-23 deal the stock fell -20.9% (9-23), -19.2% (9-28), -12.5% (9-29), -14.2% (10-01) and today about -13.8%, with next-close moves of +33.1, -12.5, +2.4 and -13.8 (baseline history.events): continuation on two of four, violent bounces on the others.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the overhang so far, but how many of the ~4.5m deal shares are still held is not disclosed anywhere; if it were spent, volume would have collapsed and the falls stopped, and instead the stock printed another double-digit fall today on 1.5x normal volume.
findings.independence: Baseline run_up_5d_pct -38.8% against run_up_20d_pct +87.1%: the whole post-deal week is a decline from above the deal prices. Same baseline, not independent of the price.

findings.finding: The 9-28 purchase agreement bars the company from any financing for 30 days after the ~9-29 closing and from variable-rate deals for six months, and the A.G.P. ATM was terminated, so no issuer offering or ATM draw can land inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The covenant runs from ~2026-09-29 to ~2026-10-29 and therefore covers the whole window; it removes the commonest second shoe for a serial issuer (six 424B5s since August).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None directly comparable: in every earlier post-deal week (8-24, 8-27, 9-23, 9-28) a further offering followed within days, so this is the first stretch with the issuer contractually out of the market.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 9-28, so mostly priced; what it adds is that, unlike most fallers with an open ATM, no fresh issuer supply can arrive overnight. A 'subject to certain exceptions' carve-out means it is not absolute, which is why it is small.

findings.finding: Director Riad El-Dada filed a Form 144 on 2026-10-01 to sell 3,500 RSU shares (~$31.9k), a token sale.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The sale was dated 10-01 and is done; the matching Form 4 may post within the window and could be read as an insider selling into weakness.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial in size (0.03% of shares); filed because it is a sourced fact inside the window, not because it carries weight.

outside_window.finding: 30-day no-financing covenant from the 9-28 SPA expires around 2026-10-29, after which the serial issuer (six 424B5s since 2026-08-24, $100m shelf) can return to the market.
